flows.name: niagara_fire
flows.description: Build a fire Niagara system from scratch (spawn rate, upward velocity, HDR orange colour) and verify it emits. A 0-to-1 best-practice starting point, not a demo. Lands at /Game/VFX/Fire/NS_Fire; override name/packagePath via params.

flows.name: beacon
flows.description: Demo - build a shrine scene from scratch: floor, pedestal, orb, five pillars, four materials (dark stone, brushed metal, warm stone, parameterized emissive), colored lights, and atmosphere

flows.name: texture_bomb
flows.description: Build a reusable MF_TextureBomb MaterialFunction (#491). Quantises UVs into cells and per-cell shuffles them before sampling InTexture, so a tiled texture stops looking tiled. Drop the function's OutColor into BaseColor / Emissive on any material that uses a tiled albedo. CellDensity input controls the cell frequency. Lives at /Game/Materials/Functions/MF_TextureBomb.

flows.name: neon_shrine
flows.description: Build the full Neon Shrine demo scene end-to-end (19 steps). Driven by the demo.step handler shipped with the bridge plugin. Leaves the editor on /Game/Demo/DemoLevel; run neon_shrine_cleanup to wipe it.

flows.name: neon_shrine_cleanup
flows.description: Wipe the Neon Shrine demo content. Switches the editor to /Game/MCP_Home first so you don't get stranded on Untitled.
